subject.title: improve(ui): restyle composer send button as filled accent circle

question: Should the Control UI composer send action remain aligned with the shipped shared ghost-button styling, or become the filled accent primary action proposed here?
rationale: Both directions are technically viable, and this PR deliberately reverses a recent merged visual decision; repository history and automated checks cannot determine the intended design system.

options.title: Adopt filled primary action
options.body: Approve the filled accent circle and arrow-up convention, then rebase and land this focused patch after clean exact-head validation.

options.title: Retain shared ghost styling
options.body: Keep the recently shipped ghost-button treatment and decline this visual reversal to preserve the current shared control language.

recommendation.title: Adopt filled primary action
recommendation.body: Approve the filled accent circle and arrow-up convention, then rebase and land this focused patch after clean exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current composer ghost-button treatment and are the strongest history-based routing candidate for its original design intent.
